intro: Adoni is a cotton trading town in Kurnool district, and its schools and residential layouts deal with long, dry summers on hard, rocky ground. FunPlay Systems is a playground equipment manufacturer that supplies Adoni from our factory in Vasai, about 620 km away. We make swings, slides, climbers and multi play systems in-house, send them by road and install them with our own team or a dealer in the region.

Most enquiries from a town like Adoni come from school managements, layout developers and community trusts setting up a small park. Each of them wants equipment that copes with the heat and needs little attention. Our posts are galvanised steel and our slides and panels are roto-moulded plastic. Both are weather-proof and corrosion-resistant, which matters when one piece faces a scorching April and a wet September. Send us a photo of your ground and we will tell you whether grouting or a self-standing base suits it.

sections.h: Planning shade and sun direction for an Adoni playground
sections.html:
In Rayalaseema the sun is the main thing to plan around. Where you can, turn slides so the sliding surface faces away from the afternoon sun, and place swings where a building or a row of trees throws shade after lunch. Lighter colours from our 15+ roto-moulded shades stay more comfortable to touch than dark ones.

A gazebo or pergola from our garden decor range gives parents a shaded place to sit beside the play area. For an adult fitness corner on the same plot, see our outdoor gym equipment in Adoni.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on rocky ground in Adoni?
faq.a: Yes. On hard or rocky ground we usually grout the posts into a concrete base. Where the surface is already paved and level, some pieces can stand on their own. We decide this from your site photos.

faq.q: Which colours are best for a sunny playground?
faq.a: Lighter shades such as yellows, light blues and greens heat up less than dark colours in direct sun. We offer 15+ roto-moulded shades, so you can pick a combination that suits both the heat and your building.

faq.q: What warranty comes with equipment sent to Adoni?
faq.a: The same as everywhere in India. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry 3 years. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year, for manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.

intro: Agartala sits close to the Bangladesh border, about 1,960 km from our factory in Vasai. That is a long way, and it is still within our delivery area. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing complexes, government offices and parks in Agartala and across Tripura, and we send every order by road to your site.

Distance changes how you should plan an order. It pays to finalise the full list of equipment, the colours and the layout before dispatch, so everything reaches Agartala in one consignment and installation can begin as soon as it arrives. We share a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, and you approve it along with the quote before we start manufacturing. Tripura gets heavy rain for a large part of the year, so tell us about drainage on your plot early. It affects both the base we suggest and the best time to install.

sections.h: Getting a long-distance order right for Agartala
sections.html:
Three things save trouble on a project this far from Vasai. First, check that a loaded truck can reach the site, or tell us how far the equipment must be carried by hand. Second, have the ground ready, levelled and drained, before the equipment arrives. Third, keep one person on your side who can approve small changes quickly by phone.

For the rains, plan a raised base with a slope and rubber flooring under the play pieces. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle wet weather without rusting. See the Tripura page for other towns we supply, or our outdoor gym equipment in Agartala.

faq.q: Do you really deliver playground equipment to Agartala?
faq.a: Yes. Everything is made at our Vasai factory and sent to Agartala by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in the region, using grouting or a self-standing base.

faq.q: What should we prepare before the equipment reaches our site?
faq.a: A cleared, level and well-drained area matching the layout drawing, clear truck access, and a person who can receive the consignment. If the base needs concrete for grouting, we will tell you in advance.

faq.q: Is there a best season to install a playground in Tripura?
faq.a: Installation is easier in the drier months, since grouting and rubber flooring need dry ground to set well. If you must install during the rains, keep a covered area for the equipment and allow for weather breaks.

intro: Agra receives visitors from across the world because of the Taj Mahal, and many of its hotels, resorts and banquet lawns now want a play area for families who travel with children. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor playground equipment manufacturer and supplier for these sites and for Agra's schools and residential colonies. We build the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,010 km away, and send it by road for installation.

Agra's weather is hard on outdoor equipment from both sides. Summers on the Yamuna plains are extremely hot and dusty, and winter mornings bring cold and fog. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit this range well, because neither rusts in the damp months and both are weather-proof. Hotels often ask us for equipment that looks good in photographs and fits the colours of the property. With 15+ roto-moulded shades and design customisation on request, we can usually match a lawn's look without building something from scratch.

sections.h: Play areas for Agra's hotels and family resorts
sections.html:
A hotel play area works best when parents can watch from a seat or a restaurant window. Keep it away from the pool and the driveway, and leave a clear safe play area around each piece. A themed multi play station such as Castle Crest or a wooden tower from the NexLev series gives the lawn a feature that families notice.

Dust settles on slides and decks through summer, so ask your staff to wipe them down daily in the dry months. Rubber flooring under the equipment is easier to keep clean than grass or soil. Corporate guests may also want our outdoor gym equipment in Agra.

faq.q: Can you match playground colours to our hotel's look?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Our roto-moulded parts come in 15+ shades and we offer design customisation on request. Share photos of the property and we will suggest equipment and colours that sit well with it.

faq.q: How much lawn space does a small hotel play area need?
faq.a: It depends on the pieces you choose, because each has its own safe play area. Send us the length and width of the lawn and we will mark a layout that fits, with space for parents to sit.

faq.q: Does the equipment handle Agra's summer heat and winter fog?
faq.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof and do not rust in damp winter months. In summer, place slides away from the afternoon sun so the surfaces stay comfortable to touch.

intro: Ahmednagar lies on the Deccan plateau, about 200 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes it one of the closer district towns we serve. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Ahmednagar to schools, housing societies, cooperative institutions and municipal gardens. Everything is designed and made in-house, then sent by road and installed by our team or a dealer.

Many buyers here have a fixed budget for this year and plans to add more later. That is a sensible way to build a playground. You can start with a few core pieces such as a swing set, a slide and a see-saw, and add a multi play system or climbers in the next year. We draw the full layout at the start, marking where each future piece will go and the safe play area around it, so the first pieces do not block the later ones. The district gets less rain than coastal Maharashtra, and the hard, dry ground usually suits grouted posts.

sections.h: Building an Ahmednagar playground in phases
sections.html:
1. Share the plot size, the age groups and photos. We prepare one layout drawing for the complete playground.
  2. Pick the pieces for phase one. Swings, slides and see-saws give the most play for a smaller budget.
  3. We manufacture, dispatch and install phase one, leaving the space for later pieces clear.
  4. When funds allow, you order the next pieces from the same drawing.

You can see the kind of work we do in Maharashtra in our Raymond project in Thane. For adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Ahmednagar.

faq.q: Can we buy a few pieces now and add more next year?
faq.a: Yes. We draw the full layout first and mark which pieces come in each phase. Later orders fit into the same plan, and the safe play areas are worked out for the complete playground from the start.

faq.q: Which method of installation suits dry ground in Ahmednagar?
faq.a: Hard, dry ground usually suits grouting, where the posts are set into a concrete base. On an existing paved or concrete surface some pieces can be self-standing. We confirm the method from your site photos.

faq.q: Who installs the equipment in Ahmednagar?
faq.a: Our own installation team or a dealer working with us. The equipment is manufactured at Vasai, sent by road, and installed to the layout drawing you approved.

intro: Aizawl is built along steep ridges, and flat open ground is scarce. A playground here usually has to fit a terrace, a school courtyard or a narrow strip beside a church or community hall. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, about 2,100 km away, and sends it by road to Mizoram for installation.

On a hill site the first questions are about slope and access, before the equipment is chosen. Tell us how much the ground falls across the plot, how wide the approach road is and whether the last stretch has steps. With that, we can suggest compact pieces such as spring riders, small slides and climbers that fit tight spaces, or a multi play system if you have a levelled terrace. Mizoram has a long, wet monsoon, so we will also ask where rainwater runs off the plot. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle the damp well.

sections.h: Fitting play equipment on Aizawl's slopes
sections.html:
Play equipment needs level ground, so a sloping plot is usually cut into one or two flat terraces with a retaining edge. Each terrace can hold a different age group, which also keeps toddlers away from older children. Leave the full safe play area flat around every piece, and never let a slide end towards a drop.

Small spring riders and climbers suit narrow terraces, since they need less space than a swing. Rubber flooring drains faster than soil after rain. See the Mizoram page or our outdoor gym equipment in Aizawl.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on sloping ground?
faq.a: The ground under each piece and its safe play area must be level. On a slope we suggest cutting one or more flat terraces first. We mark these on the layout drawing so the civil work can be planned.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a small hill-town site?
faq.a: Spring riders, small slides, see-saws and compact climbers need little space. If you have one good level terrace, a small multi play system fits several activities into one footprint.

faq.q: Do you send playground equipment to Mizoram?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai and send the order to Aizawl by road. Tell us about the access road and any steps near the site so we can plan the dispatch.

intro: Ajmer draws pilgrims all year to the Dargah, and visitors heading on to Pushkar pass through as well. That keeps the town's hotels, guest houses and dharamshalas busy with families. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Ajmer to these properties and to the town's schools and housing colonies. We make it at our factory in Vasai, about 810 km away, and install it with our team or a dealer.

A hotel or guest house rarely has a big lawn. More often there is a courtyard, a terrace garden or a corner beside the parking area. That calls for a small, well-chosen set, such as a compact multi play station or two or three individual pieces, placed where parents can watch. Ajmer is hot and dry for much of the year, and dust blows in from the Aravalli hills. We suggest a surface that is easy to sweep and pieces with smooth roto-moulded parts that wipe clean quickly.

sections.h: Small play corners for Ajmer's hotels and guest houses
sections.html:
For a courtyard of modest size, a small multi play station from Play Lands combines a slide, steps and a deck in one footprint. Spring riders and a see-saw add play for younger children without much extra space. Keep the play corner away from the gate and vehicle movement, and mark its edge with a low fence or planter.

In the dry months, dust and grit gather on slides and steps, so a quick daily wipe keeps them pleasant to use. Our Rajasthan page lists other towns we serve, and we also supply outdoor gym equipment in Ajmer.

faq.q: Can you fit a play area into a hotel courtyard in Ajmer?
faq.a: Yes, if the courtyard has space for the safe play area around each piece. Send us its length, width and a few photos. We will suggest compact equipment and show it on a layout drawing.

faq.q: How do we keep playground equipment clean in dusty weather?
faq.a: Wipe slides, steps and handholds with a damp cloth regularly in the dry months. Roto-moulded plastic has a smooth surface that cleans easily, and rubber flooring can be swept and washed.

faq.q: Can the equipment be installed on an existing paved courtyard?
faq.a: Some pieces can be installed self-standing on a firm, level paved surface. Others need grouting into a concrete base. We confirm this for each piece once we see your photos.

intro: In Akola, most of our playground enquiries come from schools. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Akola's schools, housing societies and municipal gardens at our factory in Vasai, about 450 km away. We deliver to Vidarbha by road and install with our own team or a dealer, either grouted into the ground or self-standing.

A school ground has a problem a society garden does not have. The same space must work for a four-year-old in pre-primary and a twelve-year-old in the senior classes. Mixing them on one structure leads to collisions and crowding. We plan school playgrounds in separate zones, with low slides, spring riders and small climbers for the youngest children and taller climbers, nets and bigger multi play systems for the older ones. Akola's summers are very hot, so we also look at where shade falls during the hours children are outside.

sections.h: Dividing an Akola school ground by age group
sections.html:
• Pre-primary zone: 3 ft slides, spring riders and a toddler swing, close to the classrooms so teachers can watch.
  • Primary zone: a multi play system, see-saws and a merry-go-round for group play.
  • Older children: climbers and net structures that need strength and balance.

Keep a walkway between zones so children do not cut through a swing path. We mark each zone and its safe play area on the layout drawing. For a teachers' or parents' fitness corner, see our outdoor gym equipment in Akola.

faq.q: How should a school in Akola plan equipment for different classes?
faq.a: Split the ground into zones by age. Low slides and spring riders suit pre-primary children, while primary and older children need climbers and larger structures. We mark these zones on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Can school playground equipment take heavy daily use?
faq.a: Our equipment is built from galvanised steel, roto-moulded plastic and composite laminates. The 3-year warranty on these parts covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as we instruct.

faq.q: What do you need from us to suggest equipment?
faq.a: The length and width of the space, the age groups and number of children who will use it, and a few photos. We then suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

intro: Alappuzha's resorts, homestays and houseboat operators host many families, and a play lawn by the water gives children something to do between boat rides. FunPlay Systems is a playground equipment manufacturer supplying Alappuzha's resorts, schools and housing projects from our factory in Vasai, about 1,160 km away. We send the equipment by road to Kerala and install it with our team or a dealer.

Few places are wetter than Alappuzha. It gets rain from both the southwest and the northeast monsoons, the land is low and close to the backwaters, and the air near the coast carries salt. Bare iron does not last in these conditions. Galvanised steel posts, roto-moulded plastic parts and composite laminates are weather-proof and corrosion-resistant, so they suit a lakeside lawn far better. Where the ground stays soft or waterlogged, we suggest raising the play area and grouting the posts into a concrete base.

sections.h: Choosing equipment for a backwater resort lawn
sections.html:
Resort guests like play pieces that suit the setting. Our Kagzi range is inspired by paper folding, and the Paper Boat station, with a slide and net tunnel, sits naturally beside a canal. Keep the play area well back from the water's edge and fence the side facing the backwater.

Rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time to remove salt, and check bolts during each monsoon. A raised, sloped base with rubber flooring dries faster than lawn grass. For guests who want to exercise, see our outdoor gym equipment in Alappuzha.

faq.q: Will playground equipment rust near the backwaters?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are corrosion-resistant, which is why we use them. Near salt air, rinse the equipment with fresh water now and then and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.

faq.q: Can you install on soft or waterlogged ground?
faq.a: We suggest raising the play area above the surrounding ground and grouting the posts into a concrete base. A slight slope and rubber flooring help water drain away after heavy rain.

faq.q: Do you have designs that suit a resort setting?
faq.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals ranges, including Kagzi and Nature Sparsh, are designed by our own team and look different from standard park equipment. We also offer design customisation on request.

intro: Aligarh is famous for its locks and hardware, so many buyers here know metalwork well and ask sharp questions about it. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Aligarh's schools, colleges, housing colonies and parks. We fabricate, roto-mould and inspect everything in-house at our factory in Vasai, about 1,080 km away. It then goes by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer.

The most common question we hear from Aligarh is how our steel is protected. The posts and frames are galvanised pipe, which means the steel carries a zinc coating that protects it against rust. That is different from painted mild steel, which looks the same on day one but starts to rust where the paint chips. Our slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic, which cannot rust at all. The warranty reflects this, with 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts.

sections.h: What to check in a playground quote
sections.html:
When you compare quotes for an Aligarh school or society, ask each supplier the same questions:

  • Are the pipes galvanised or only painted?
  • Are slides and panels roto-moulded, and in how many colours?
  • What does the warranty cover, and for how long on springs and bearings?
  • Will they send a layout drawing showing the safe play area?

Our answers are on our FAQ page, and we put them in writing with every quote. For adults on the same campus, see our outdoor gym equipment in Aligarh.

faq.q: What is the difference between galvanised and painted steel?
faq.a: Galvanised steel has a zinc coating that protects it from rust even if the surface is scratched. Painted mild steel rusts wherever the paint chips. Our posts and frames are galvanised pipe.

faq.q: Do you make the equipment yourselves?
faq.a: Yes. Design, fabrication and roto-moulding are done in-house at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, and every piece goes through our own quality inspection before dispatch.

faq.q: Can a college campus in Aligarh order both play and gym equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Many campuses want a play area for staff families and an outdoor gym for students. We can plan both on one layout drawing and send them in the same dispatch.

intro: Allahabad, now officially Prayagraj, is a city of courts, government offices, universities and coaching institutes, and many of its playground buyers are public bodies. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Allahabad to municipal parks, government and institutional campuses, schools and housing colonies. Our factory in Vasai is about 1,140 km away, and we send each order by road and install it with our own team or a dealer.

Public buyers need paperwork as much as equipment. Before an order is placed, a park or campus committee usually wants to see what will go where, how much space it takes and what the warranty covers. Our layout drawing answers the first two, with the safe play area marked around each piece. The written warranty answers the third. On the ground, plan for very hot summers and for the monsoon on the flat plains near the Ganga and Yamuna, where low-lying parks can hold water after heavy rain.

sections.h: Buying for a public park or government campus
sections.html:
Public parks get heavy use, often from morning till late evening, by children of every age. Choose sturdy pieces that several children can use at once, such as a merry-go-round, double swings and a multi play system. Spread them out so crowds do not gather in one spot.

Ask for a layout drawing early. It helps your committee approve the space and the budget, and it shows the safe play areas your civil team must keep clear. If the park sits low, raise the play area and grout the posts. See the Uttar Pradesh page or our outdoor gym equipment in Allahabad.

faq.q: Can you provide a layout drawing for committee approval?
faq.a: Yes. Share the park or campus dimensions, the age groups and photos. We send a layout drawing showing each piece and its safe play area, along with the quote, before anything is manufactured.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a busy public park in Prayagraj?
faq.a: Pieces that many children can use at the same time, such as merry-go-rounds, double swings, see-saws and multi play systems. Spreading them across the park reduces crowding around any one piece.

faq.q: What happens if the park floods during the monsoon?
faq.a: We suggest raising the play area slightly and grouting posts into concrete. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof, but drainage should be planned before installation.

intro: Alwar lies on the edge of the National Capital Region, between the Aravalli hills and the Delhi to Jaipur road, and new residential townships have been coming up around it. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Alwar to builders, housing societies, schools and resorts near Sariska. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, about 990 km away, and send everything by road for installation.

For a builder, the play area is part of what sells the flats, and it needs to be in place and looking good before handover. We help by suggesting equipment that fits the space marked on your site plan and drawing it to scale with the safe play area around it. Your architect can then plan paths, lighting and seating around it. Alwar has very hot, dusty summers and cool winters. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle both, and lighter colours stay cooler in the sun.

sections.h: Play areas for new residential projects in Alwar
sections.html:
Start with the space on your approved site plan, then decide the age groups. A township with many young families usually needs two areas, a toddler corner and a larger set for older children. A multi play system from Forestia or Robo Romp gives a themed centrepiece for brochures and site visits.

Share your plan with us before the landscaping is finalised. Grouted posts need concrete footings, and it is easier to cast them before paving goes in. For the clubhouse or jogging track, see our outdoor gym equipment in Alwar.

faq.q: Can you work from our architect's site plan?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the plan with the play area marked. We suggest equipment that fits and return a layout drawing to scale, with the safe play area shown, so your architect can plan around it.

faq.q: When should a builder involve the playground supplier?
faq.a: Before landscaping and paving are finalised. Grouted posts need concrete footings, and flooring levels must suit the equipment, so early planning avoids breaking new paving later.

faq.q: Do you offer themed playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Our CoreCraft range includes castle, jungle, circus and robot themes, and our Funplay Originals are designed in-house, many inspired by Indian games and nature.

intro: Amaravati, the capital region of Andhra Pradesh, lies on the south bank of the Krishna between Vijayawada and Guntur. Much of the land is open and flat, and many sites start without trees, paths or buildings around them. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Amaravati to government and institutional campuses, schools, residential projects and public parks. We make it at our Vasai factory and send it by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

An empty site is easier to plan than a crowded one, but it needs more thought. There is no shade, nothing to break the wind and no natural boundary to keep children away from roads. The Krishna delta climate is hot and humid, and the monsoon can leave flat ground soggy for days. We suggest you settle the drainage, the paths and some tree planting at the same time as the playground, so everything grows together.

sections.h: Planning a playground on an open Amaravati site
sections.html:
On a large plot, place the play area near seating and toilets, and away from vehicle entry. Split it into an area for small children and one for older children, joined by a path. A larger structure from the NexLev series can anchor the space, with swings and see-saws around it.

Until trees grow, a gazebo or pergola gives parents shade. Raise the play area slightly and lay rubber flooring so it drains after rain. Our Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh page lists more towns, and we also supply outdoor gym equipment in Amaravati.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground for a large, empty plot?
faq.a: Yes. Share the plot dimensions, entry points and the age groups expected. We suggest equipment and zones and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked for each piece.

faq.q: How do we handle shade on a new site with no trees?
faq.a: Plant trees along the edges as early as possible and add a gazebo or pergola for seating. Place slides so their surfaces face away from the afternoon sun.

faq.q: Do you deliver to the Amaravati capital region?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai and send the equipment by road. Our installation team or a dealer installs it, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.
